narrative.northStar: Place content, retain its source, then generate and inspect it.
narrative.overview:
The built surface is Generation → Design → Image composition, an **Operate** extension of the existing Prospero workbench. A saved-source selector and Guardar copia precede the editable canvas. The inspector edits scene intent, literal text, pixel geometry and retained image references. Plantillas remains the adjacent mode and the initial Designer choice.

The visual authority is the incumbent plum application with magenta actions and selection, shared fields and compact buttons. The white canvas is the artifact being composed. This scoped record was completed after implementation and the independent visual finish review; the Direction contract below was itself written after the first build. Neither is evidence of an earlier comp or workshop. The north-star wording comes directly from that existing contract.
keyCharacteristics: Source selection and save remain above the editable artifact.
Rectangular boxes distinguish requested placement from a generated image.
Parallel desktop inspection becomes sequential mobile inspection.
Compiled instructions, export, preview and generation follow the work area.

rules.name: The Artifact Ground Rule
rules.body: Preserve the white composition canvas and use the shared theme accent for application actions, focus and box selection.

rules.name: The Retained Source Rule
rules.body: Keep editable source identity separate from the schematic preview and generated image; inspect the engine result before claiming placement or spelling adherence.

dos: Do preserve the source selector and save action before the canvas.
Do retain the white artifact, shared plum controls and magenta selection.
Do keep the desktop inspector alongside and mobile inspector after the canvas.
Do retain labeled exact text, numeric geometry and wrapping downstream actions.
Do distinguish retained source, schematic preview and generated result in evidence.
donts: Don't replace Plantillas or introduce a new visual world for this extension.
Don't treat a session draft as a durable saved composition.
Don't equate successful compilation or demo transport with real-model adherence.
Don't describe viewport captures or scoped ship as whole-product or old-comp approval.
Don't package QA screenshots as application imagery or imply new shipping raster assets.
